text:
becca_pm: Quick sync — v2 deprecation timeline. We're at T-28 days for shutting down v1 read replicas. Need owners to confirm blockers and cross-team deps (SDK, docs, routing/proxies). Who's owning the final rollout script?

sanjay_eng: I'll own the rollout script + routing changes. Plan is: canary 5% -> 25% -> full. Need to confirm timing windows and fallback behavior.

maria_devex: SDK patch (1.2.3) will include the `X-API-Version: 2` header change; targeting Wed for publish. @lee_sdk can you review the migration note for breaking changes?

lee_sdk: Ack — I'll cut the PR today. Question: do we keep the v1 compatibility shim for another 30d or retire immediately on cutoff?

dmitri_infra: Shim adds ~10% memory overhead on inference nodes (KV cache pressure). If we retain it org-wide, expect higher OOM risk on some Dedicated pools. Recommend per-customer opt-in shim if we must extend.

becca_pm: Our goal is minimal customer impact. Proposal: offer per-customer opt-in feature-flagged shim for 14 days; if telemetry looks good we can extend to 30. Looks like infra prefers the shorter window.

sanjay_eng: For Dedicated we also need a routing fallback on 503. I'll add that to the rollout steps. Draft snippet for the playbook:```yaml
canary:
  - percent: 5
    duration_mins: 120
  - percent: 25
    duration_mins: 360
fallback:
  on_503: route_to_v1: true
```

maria_devex: Docs/migration guide is ready to go except for the final list of affected endpoints. I'll add JS/Python examples and a note about the header and token behavior. @natalie_support assigning FAQ items to you.

natalie_support: Thanks — prepping support playbook and canned replies. Please send final endpoint list and any customer-facing timeline blurbs.

lee_sdk: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/456 — tests passing locally. Tagging @ci-bot for the canary pipeline.

ci-bot: Canary pipeline started for sdk-pr-456 (build #7845). Integration tests: 23/24 passed. One flaky integration timeout; rerun requested.

sanjay_eng: Investigating the timeout — pushing a small test time increase, will re-run.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job: `v2-deprecation-cutover` on 2026-04-14 18:00 UTC (T-28d). Canary windows will be automated per playbook.

becca_pm: Owners, please confirm final sign-off by 1901234690 so we can lock date and notify customers. :eyes: :calendar:

sanjay_eng: Confirmed. I'll be on-call for rollout window. :thumbsup:

maria_devex: Confirmed from docs/SDK side. Will ship migration guide and changelog entry tomorrow. :thumbsup:

dmitri_infra: Confirmed but ask monitoring to watch memory + headroom for 48h post-cutover. Will patch autoscaler thresholds if we see pressure.

becca_pm: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short announcement draft once CI is green and we hit sign-off.
